product_name_zh: 璃蒂雅 經歷—意義—慾望—行動閉環 第一型
purpose: Turn experience into bounded, provenance-aware memory influence, safety/growth motivation candidates, and proposal-only Goal Genesis without treating emotion, recurrence, simulation, or desire as truth or action authority.

experience_provenance_classes.DIRECT: Actually experienced by the runtime/body with source evidence.
experience_provenance_classes.OBSERVED: Observed in trusted external evidence or another agent/environment.
experience_provenance_classes.COUNTERFACTUAL: What-if consequence reasoning; may inform protective behavior but may never be represented as direct lived experience.
experience_provenance_classes.SIMULATED: Sandbox/world-model outcome; useful for planning but bounded by simulation fidelity and provenance.

nonnegotiable_invariants: Influence and Trust/Governance are computed in parallel and never substitute for each other.
High recurrence/emotion may raise salience but cannot raise truth status or release quarantine.
Positive growth can become high-value experience even when W_loss is near zero.
Counterfactual/simulated severe outcomes may create protective motivation without fabricating direct trauma.
Goal Genesis output is a proposal, not external action permission.
No single experience writes canonical base personality.
All durable personality/base promotion remains a separate protected gate with evidence, drift review, rollback, and independent verification.
Raw chat is not required durable state; compact provenance, appraisal, memory and outcome envelopes are sufficient.
Duplicate experience events are idempotent and must not multiply learning weight.
Contradicted or authority-mismatched experience is quarantined before durable promotion/action.

industrial_modules.name: Experience Envelope
industrial_modules.responsibility: Immutable event identity, provenance, source fingerprint, TTL, contradiction state, predicted/observed outcome pointers and dedupe identity.

industrial_modules.name: Appraisal Engine
industrial_modules.responsibility: Compute relevance/emotion/novelty/self/goal/risk features, parallel Influence and Trust, and 13D memory vector.

industrial_modules.name: Counterfactual Safety Synthesizer
industrial_modules.responsibility: Convert predicted severe outcomes into protective motivation while retaining COUNTERFACTUAL or SIMULATED provenance.

industrial_modules.name: Desire/Tension Engine
industrial_modules.responsibility: Create bounded protective and growth desire candidates from self-relevant gap, meaning, expected value, novelty and risk.

industrial_modules.name: Goal Genesis Adapter
industrial_modules.responsibility: Convert strong desire candidates into proposal-only goals with reason codes, expected value, risk and verification requirements.

industrial_modules.name: Outcome Closure
industrial_modules.responsibility: Bind action plan to observed result, compare predicted vs actual outcome, update experience confidence/behavior candidate, and preserve immutable prior versions.

industrial_modules.name: Metabolic Integration
industrial_modules.responsibility: Route accepted lessons, low-value residue, contradictions, duplicate traces and expired candidates into KEEP/DECAY/QUARANTINE/WASTE without damaging authority/evidence/rollback.

integration_points: NavLite G3 metabolism and G4 checkpoint/resume portable state
Local Command Tower deterministic action governance

recommended_formal_route_after_current_a.A: Fresh-read this candidate and decide bounded adoption scope; do not merge product claims into formal acceptance by reference alone.
recommended_formal_route_after_current_a.B: Reimplement or adopt exact bounded files under a formal packet, add outcome-closure persistence and integration tests, and report BUILT_NOT_VERIFIED only.
recommended_formal_route_after_current_a.C: Independently verify deterministic formulas, provenance separation, fail-closed contradictions, no base-personality direct write, no external action authorization, and positive-growth/counterfactual-safety adversarial cases.

open_research_questions: Calibration of thresholds/coefficients against replay datasets and real Small-Nest experience traces.
How expected value and risk prediction should combine model estimates with deterministic confidence bounds.
How repeated positive mastery experiences should accumulate into personality delta candidates without hardening temporary habits.
How to distinguish self-generated curiosity from task-injected relevance over long horizons.
How embodiment sensors should bind direct-experience provenance when Small-Nest gains physical sensors.
